title: Mizzen drift report
description: `drift.json` in the output folder: every drift finding grouped by page URL, per-page coverage, and the evidence each page's findings were computed from. Page keys are output URLs including `base`, in code-point order. A computed finding carries the diagnostic's message, help, exact documentation source span, and structured code target, so it can be repaired without rerunning the scanner. `coverage` names every doc page, including pages with no findings, and says whether this run measured it. Evidence names the SHA-256 of the page content and of each cited source, or the marker that says why a source was not read. Identical inputs write identical bytes; no absolute path or wall-clock value appears.

pages.description: Findings per page URL, keyed in code-point order. A page with no findings is absent.

coverage.description: One entry per doc page, keyed in code-point order, so zero findings and an unmeasured page stay distinct.

evidence.description: Evidence per doc page URL, keyed in code-point order.

url.description: An output URL, including `base`. It always starts with `/`.

finding.description: One finding. `kind`, `reference`, and `severity` are always present; a computed finding also has `message`, `help`, `source`, and `target`.

kind.description: The check ID that found it, such as `drift.missing-file`.

reference.description: The code reference the page makes, such as `src/app.ts:12`, `src/app.ts:10-14`, or `src/app.ts:12:7`.

message.description: What is wrong, in one sentence.

help.description: How to repair the claim, when the check offers one.

source.description: The exact documentation span the finding was judged at.

target.description: The structured code target and the identity of the source bytes it was judged against.

span.description: A span in a source file. Lines and columns are 1-based and inclusive, and the end is at or after the start.

file.description: The page's source file, relative to the site root.

endColumn.description: Column of the span's last character.

target.description: The code target a finding judged, and the identity recorded in `evidence.sources` for its path.

path.description: The cited file, relative to the site root.

endLine.description: The last cited line of a range; absent for one line.

column.description: The cited column; absent when the reference names only lines.

identity.description: The source identity from `evidence`: a SHA-256, or `missing`/`outside` when the source could not be read.

coverage.description: Whether and how thoroughly one page was measured.

checked.description: True only when this run measured the page, or reused evidence that still matches.

findings.description: How many findings the report holds for the page; zero means none were found, not that the page was skipped.

evidence.description: What a page's findings were computed from, and whether they still hold.

version.description: The evidence format; only 1 is read.

state.description: `fresh` evidence was measured or still matches; `stale` no longer matches; `unknown` means none exists; `unavailable` means the sources could not be read.

content.description: SHA-256 of the page content the findings came from; absent when nothing was measured.

sources.description: Per cited path, the source identity the findings came from; absent when nothing was measured.

identity.description: A SHA-256 of the source bytes, `missing` when the file does not exist, or `outside` when it resolves outside the site root.

path.description: A relative path with forward slashes: no leading slash, drive letter, backslash, `..` segment, or control character.
